description: This file defines the 'Image_Canvas_WithMap' class, which extends 'Image_Canvas' to add support for generating HTML image maps along with various drawing functionalities such as lines, polygons, rectangles, ellipses, pieslices, text, and image overlays. It manages an internal 'ImageMap' object to handle image map specific operations.

classes.name: Image_Canvas_WithMap
classes.description: A subclass of Image_Canvas that adds image mapping capabilities, including methods to draw shapes, add text, overlay images, and retrieve the image map object.

methods.name: Image_Canvas_WithMap
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the canvas and optionally creates an image map if 'usemap' parameter is true.

methods.name: line
methods.description: Draws a line on the canvas and, if available, on the associated image map.

methods.name: addVertex
methods.description: Adds a vertex to a polygon, affecting both the canvas and image map.

methods.name: addSpline
methods.description: Adds a spline vertex to a polygon, affecting both the canvas and image map.

methods.name: polygon
methods.description: Draws a polygon on the canvas and adds it to the image map if available.

methods.name: rectangle
methods.description: Draws a rectangle on the canvas and adds it to the image map if available.

methods.name: ellipse
methods.description: Draws an ellipse on the canvas and adds it to the image map if available.

methods.name: pieslice
methods.description: Draws a pie slice on the canvas and adds it to the image map if available.

methods.name: addText
methods.description: Adds text to the canvas and to the image map if available.

methods.name: image
methods.description: Overlays an image on the canvas and to the image map if available.

methods.name: getImageMap
methods.description: Retrieves the associated image map object.
